compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Validation sprint orchestration: run /dso:sprint on a candidate epic of ≥1500 LOC across ≥3 stories using all the new mechanisms. Verify mechanical proxies pass (draft PR exists from Phase A; readable DSO-Story trailers; reviewer-findings.json + GitHubPRDefenseStore writes; final-PR DefenseStore returns attestations covering merged stories; leakage 5-case test matrix passes). Inline value-signal assertion: re-reviewed-LOC / total-LOC < 50%.
**Why**: Demonstrates that the mechanism reduces re-review surface in practice.

**Scope**:
- IN: Identify a candidate epic of ≥1500 LOC across ≥3 stories that does not depend on this epic's mechanisms (no circular dependency)
- IN: Run /dso:sprint end-to-end on that epic
- IN: Capture mechanical proxy verifications and the re-review ratio
- IN: Document results in a validation report committed to docs/findings/
- OUT: Achieving the headline <15% re-review target — filed as follow-on observability ticket

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, the validation sprint runs end-to-end without manual intervention on a ≥1500 LOC, ≥3-story epic
  ← Satisfies: "SC8: Validation acceptance with inline value-signal"
- When this story is complete, all mechanical proxies pass: draft PR from Phase A; readable DSO-Story trailers; reviewer-findings.json + DefenseStore writes; final-PR DefenseStore returns attestations covering merged stories; leakage 5-case test matrix passes
  ← Satisfies: "SC8"
- When this story is complete, the inline value-signal assertion re-reviewed-LOC / total-LOC < 50% holds for the validation sprint
  ← Satisfies: "SC8: inline value-signal"
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Testing] The ≥1500 LOC validation sprint must use real story content (not synthetic). Identify the candidate epic or story batch BEFORE this story begins, and confirm the chosen work does not itself depend on this epic's behavior to merge. Document the chosen validation target in this story before implementation begins.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.

VALIDATION_EPIC_ID: ac1b-5e35

**Epic Title**: PR comment response: accept/defend/defer for engineer-authored PR review comments

**Story Count**: 9 stories (0fb0-e23a, 176e-905b, 238c-d60a, 46ae-e53d, 4949-c6a8, 8528-6f36, 93cb-ef60, ac9b-ef7d, b3b3-9463)

**Estimated LOC**: ~2200 LOC across new scripts, SKILL.md, orchestration logic, and integration tests:
- pr-comment-response.sh (fetch/normalize): ~300 LOC + 150 tests
- accept handler: ~200 LOC + 150 tests
- defend handler: ~150 LOC + 100 tests
- defer handler: ~150 LOC + 100 tests
- SKILL.md + entry point: ~200 LOC
- merge-to-main.sh integration: ~200 LOC + 100 tests
- human-in-loop config knob: ~150 LOC + 100 tests
- integration test suite: ~300 LOC
- docs: ~100 LOC
Total: ~2200 LOC (well above 1500 threshold)

**Dependency Check**: 
- Depends on 1083-fb3d (status: closed — dependency is satisfied)
- Relates to 7ac3-71a1 (open; relates_to is a soft link, not a hard blocker)
- No dependency on f61f-7e0a-36d3-4e7d (no circular dependency risk)
- ready_to_work: true

**Rationale**: ac1b-5e35 is the strongest validation candidate because:
1. It has 9 stories, the highest story count of any unblocked open epic with stories (exceeds the ≥3 requirement by 3x)
2. Its estimated ~2200 LOC substantially exceeds the 1500 LOC threshold
3. It has zero dependency on f61f-7e0a — its sole hard dependency (1083-fb3d) is already closed
4. All 9 stories are open and ready to work
5. It covers new shell scripts, SKILL.md authoring, orchestration logic, configuration, and integration testing — providing broad coverage of DSO workflow components for E2E validation
6. The accept/defend/defer taxonomy mirrors existing review workflow patterns, reducing integration risk

Runner-up: 8d21-3aa8 (Wire recipe library, 6 stories, ~1200 LOC estimated) — excluded because estimated LOC is below the 1500 threshold. 6add-c1fc (Semgrep integration, 4 stories, ~1000 LOC) also falls short of the LOC requirement.
